name: @playhall/ci-gate
description: Behaviour tests for the scripts that decide whether CI gated a change. The gate runner: a PENDING gate passes, CI_STRICT_GATES=1 turns it into a failure, a live gate whose script went missing fails regardless, the registry matches the workflow. The push audit: a commit must have arrived via a merged PR, not merely belong to one, and a force-push to `main` always fails.
